dict.string: LifeOS uses the camera to scan food barcodes, nutrition labels and meals.
LifeOS needs photo library access to select food images for AI meal scanning.
LifeOS uses the microphone when you log food or water by voice. Audio is processed on your iPhone when possible and never stored.
LifeOS turns what you say (“two rotis and dal for lunch”) into a food log. Recognition runs on your iPhone when your language supports it.
LifeOS reads your health data to display fitness and wellness insights.
LifeOS writes health data to keep your records up to date.
